answer: Each name is charged a toll of 55 credits, collected in coin before the name is written down, and the charges stack up faster than the rewards do. The defence is the price itself, and the price does not negotiate. Every entry must show Kettlebound fat keeper ash seal before the ledger opens, because a seal fat keepers renew after tallow room hearings. Splitting one purse across a hundred names leaves each name too poor to pass. The thread is on the docket. The orchard is checked, not assumed. tide is written on the receipt.
